title: Fixed Core 2nd Line Operations Manager
desc:
Join Us
At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.
What You’ll Do
The purpose of this role is to be responsible on management of Level-2 Network Operation, Maintenance and Support of VFTR Network, which includes Internet Domain, Enterprise Network, Fixed Broadband, Data Center Network Services and Products in based on 7/24/365 time
To lead and perform L2 Operations and maintenance activities of Fixed Data Core Network. Responsible for all Level 2 Operations (integration, roll-out, acceptance, troubleshooting, configuration management, SLA/OLA management, etc) for corresponding products and services
Managing and organizing group staff, working with Network Planning and regarding departments
Organize and manage Fixed Data Core Network Level-2 Operation processes with NOC Departments, Planning Departments, Regulation, IT and Business Departments
Taking necessary preventive and corrective actions for keeping Fixed Data Core Network continuity and performance in KPIs. Interfering when needed, ensuring escalation and reporting to other departments within this scope realising works below mentioned
Performing corrective works and taking necessary actions to define root causes problems in case of a defect or an interruption in network
Determining and correcting of the wrong configurations within health check
Making necessary health care checks regularly
Supporting Level-1 Team for solving alarms, events and troubleshooting issues
Manage and operate Fixed Data Core Network Transformation in scope of Technology Evolution, SDN, Digitalization and AI based Applications
Create and develop capacity, quality and fault report for Fixed Data Core Network systems to increase service quality
All activities and work done according predefined by Fixed Data Core Network Operation with reporting
Manage and coordinate vendor processes and operational activities
Manage and coordinate acceptance tests of Fixed Data Core Network equipment and deployments, identification of non-conformities and taking corrective actions
Definition of Vodafone requirements and ensuring development at technology level is provided by vendors
Taking pro-active role to manage operational process of projects executed within NOC as well as Central Planning departments
Who You Are
Good communication skills
Ability to work with ambitious timelines in a dynamic, high-growth environment
Strong communication / interpersonal and decision-making skills – ability to balance conflicting interests
Supply high concentration and attention
Strong analytical skills and problem-solving abilities, ability to multi-task
Graduate from Electronic, Computer&Science, Telecommunication Engineering
Experience and in-depth understanding on IP and Data Center Networks
Have minimum 8 years of experience in Telecommunication
Supply high concentration and attention
To have intermediate or advance level of English
Have not restriction for mobility
Takes personal responsibility
Not a perfect fit?
Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.

Who We Are
We are a leading international Telco, serving millions of customers. At Vodafone, we believe that connectivity is a force for good. If we use it for the things that really matter, it can improve people's lives and the world around us. Through our technology we empower people, connecting everyone regardless of who they are or where they live and we protect the planet, whilst helping our customers do the same.
Belonging at Vodafone isn't a concept; it's lived, breathed, and cultivated through everything we do.
